source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: PARTIAL COVERAGE: only the 1st-job skills, the 5th-job V skills and the 6th-job HEXA boost cores could be pulled from maplestory.io GMS 270. The 2nd/3rd/4th-job and Hyper skills and the 6th-job HEXA active skills are absent from the source (see manifest missing list) — they are not in the skillbook API (jobs 301/3010-3014 all return the same 8-skill base book), the WZ files Skill/3011/3012/3013.img do not exist, and String/Skill.img lists only the 9 base 301xxxxx IDs.
Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.
Guided Arrow, Vicious Shot and Fury of the Wild are shared Bowman 5th-job skills and also appear in the Bowmaster and Marksman folders.

15 extra-layer frames could not be retrieved (WZ API HTTP 500 origin errors after repeated retries; Relic summon/summoned/0 returns a 1x1 placeholder) — see manifest missing list; the affected layers are present but short those indices.

Guided Arrow 400031001 and Obsidian Barrier 400031041/042/043 are no-layer duplicate WZ entries of skills already covered (400031000 / 400031037/039/040); excluded, like Guided Arrow 400031001 was for Bowmaster/Marksman.
Decent/common 5th-job skills (Rope Lift, Mystic Door, Decent Sharp Eyes, etc.) are excluded, following the branch pattern for Bowmaster/Marksman.
Sol Janus / Sol Hecate (common 6th-job origin skills) were not located in Skill/40000.img or Skill/40003.img in GMS 270; same gap as Hero.
Job 301 is Pathfinder ("The Archer's Art"), the third Explorer Bowman line alongside Bowmaster (job 312) and Marksman (job 322).

skills.description: Temporarily infuses Phoenix, Frostprey, and Shadow Raven with mysterious power for a devastating attack. Can only be used when either Phoenix, Frostprey, or Shadow Raven are summoned.

skills.note: Shared Bowman V skill; also in the Bowmaster and Marksman folders. effect0-6 are the spirit-arrow projectile variants (omitted by the skillbook API; frames copied from the identical WZ skill 400031000 already pulled for Bowmaster).

skills.name: Raven Tempest
skills.description:
[Ancient Force]
Uses the power of the relic to call forth the true form of the Shadow Raven to wreak havoc. Using Raven Tempest with the down arrow key while Fury of the Wild is summoned activates Fury of the Wild Tempest which swirls even faster.
The summoned Shadow Raven/Fury of the Wild moves in search of enemies, and you can also press the skill key to manually change its direction.
Using Action Customization allows you to switch the Command of Raven Tempest and Fury of the Wild Tempest while Fury of the Wild is summoned.
Can only be used when Shadow Raven/Fury of the Wild is summoned. Raven Tempest and Fury of the Wild Tempest are unaffected by attack reflection.
Custom Command On/Off: Right-click
skills.note: Main entry; the Fury of the Wild Tempest variant is 400031067. special/special2 (summoned-raven sequences) omitted by the skillbook API; fetched from the WZ.

skills.name: Obsidian Barrier
skills.description:
[Enchant Force]
Project the relic's power as a shield to defend yourself and your party members.
Party members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking.
Obsidian Barrier's attack is unaffected by attack reflection.
Deluge Enhancement
Grants each party member a personal protective shield.
Burst Enhancement
Increases the size of the shield.
Torrent Enhancement
Allows the shield to be moved.
skills.note: Main entry; the Deluge/Burst/Torrent enhancement variants are 400031038/039/040. special omitted by the skillbook API; fetched from the WZ.

skills.name: Obsidian Barrier (Deluge)
skills.description: [Enchant Force]\nProjects the relic's power as a shield to defend yourself and your party members.\nParty members who receive the protection of this skill will receive reduced damage and will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking.
skills.note: Deluge enhancement variant of Obsidian Barrier. repeat layer omitted by the skillbook API; fetched from the WZ.

skills.name: Obsidian Barrier (Burst)
skills.description:
[Enchant Force]
Projects the relic's power as a protective shield. While within the shield, you will receive no damage from enemies' normal attacks, and reduced damage for attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage.
Party members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking.
Enhanced by the Burst emblem to defend a wider area than normal.
skills.note: Burst enhancement variant of Obsidian Barrier. effect0/special omitted by the skillbook API; fetched from the WZ.

skills.name: Obsidian Barrier (Torrent)
skills.description:
[Enchant Force]
Projects the relic's power as a protective shield. While within the shield, you will receive no damage from enemies' normal attacks, and reduced damage for attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage.
 Party members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking. 
Enhanced by the Torrent emblem to allow the shield to be moved to another location.
skills.note: Torrent enhancement variant of Obsidian Barrier. effect0/special omitted by the skillbook API; fetched from the WZ.

skills.name: Relic Unbound
skills.description:
[Enchant Force]
Sets up an attacking Relic by completely liberating the power of Relic. When Pathfinder's attack hits, Relic that was set up resonantes and attacks according to the emblem. Cannot be used if there is no Relic emblem.
Deluge Enhancement
Sets up Relic that rapidly shoots arrows at the enemy in front.
Burst Enhancement
Sets up Relic that projects arrows that explode when hit.
Torrent Enhancement
Sets up several Relics that simulatenously attack the enemy in a certain range.
